terminalContract: For full local verification only, when --lane-timeout-seconds is not explicitly supplied, bound the exclusive .NET coverage top-level lane at 1200 seconds while structure, restore, build, repository-script and Python lanes retain their 900-second default. An explicitly supplied 60-900 second lane timeout continues to bind every selected top-level lane, including .NET coverage. designReview.evidence: On 2026-09-24, independently reviewed the 1ace9c836 timed-out full-local run and two same-source UiSmoke Coverlet passes. The reviewer found that raising global DEFAULT_LANE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS would also change CI Python shard deadline at scripts/verify.py:5350, so approved only a local-full .NET coverage 1200-second default when no public timeout was explicitly supplied, preserving public custom 60-900 seconds and all CI deadlines. Approved increasing the existing single 480-second local project limit to 600 seconds for all eight projects as the smallest single-owner change without per-project scheduling branches. The 1200-second bound is a measured candidate requiring fixed-source full-verifier proof; coverage, freshness, Golden and R3 gates are not waived.
